claims.text: The model outperforms previous state-of-the-art systems on the benchmark corpus of PDTB.
The model improves classification performance on the contingency relation by 1.42 percent.
The full paragraph-level neural network model achieves the best macro-average F1-score of 48.82%, outperforming previous models by more than 2 percent.
The model outperforms the best previous system by 1 percent.
